name: Blob Photo Grid
description: Mosaic of up to 25 photos cut into organic blob shapes in a tight grid, with a hand-drawn blob-framed lightbox opened by click and navigated by arrows, keys or side buttons.
contents: Grid of up to 25 blob-masked image tiles
Fullscreen overlay lightbox with blob-shaped white frame and previous/next buttons
behavior: Tiles lift slightly on hover or focus
Click or Enter/Space on a tile opens the lightbox on that image
Arrow keys and Space step through images, Escape or backdrop click closes
Frame mask switches between portrait and landscape based on the loaded image
More tiles appear as the viewport widens, with 5 shown on small screens
editableByProps: Background, overlay and frame colors as Tailwind classes

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the blob shapes assigned to tiles

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Grid layout is fixed at 25 slots; extra images beyond 25 are ignored
Lightbox adds a window keydown listener while open and removes it on close
